stemMarkdown: Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?

options.markdown: Each of the candidates has submitted a proposal.
Each of the candidates have submitted a proposal.
Each of the candidates are submitting a proposal.
Each of the candidates were submitting a proposal.

solutionMarkdown: **Each** is always singular, however many candidates there are, so it takes **has**. The plural **candidates** belongs to the prepositional phrase and does not govern the verb.
